Container.Name: what-is-my-speed
Container.Overview: Self-hosted internet speed monitor that runs the official Ookla Speedtest CLI on a schedule. You can set up several test profiles, each with its own schedule (interval or cron) and server strategy (nearest, fixed, rotate, or every server in a list). Everything is shown on one dashboard with history charts, live test progress, server search and CSV export.[br][br] [b]Note:[/b] this container runs the Ookla Speedtest CLI. By using it, you accept Ookla's EULA (https://www.speedtest.net/about/eula) and Privacy Policy (https://www.speedtest.net/about/privacy).[br][br] To bind tests to a specific host interface (for example a VPN), set Network Type to "host". The WebUI then listens on port 3000 of the server.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the files in the data folder (Unraid default: 99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the files in the data folder (Unraid default: 100 = users).

Config.Name: Basic auth user
Config.Description: Username for the optional login prompt. Only used when a password is set.

Config.Name: Basic auth password
Config.Description: Set a password to require a login for the dashboard. Leave empty for no login.

Config.Name: Default interval (minutes)
Config.Description: Interval of the 'Auto (nearest)' profile created on first start. Change it later in the Profiles tab.

Config.Name: Update check
Config.Description: Check GitHub for new versions. The dot next to the version number at the top of the dashboard turns orange when an update is available.
